sql_reading_A.sql: SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(s.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
